title: Contract tiering experiment: SSO/SAML baseline + RBAC as configurable bundle
creator: Riley Chen
description:
Background: Sales and Legal report a recurring negotiation friction around SSO/SAML and RBAC. Customers ask for SSO (mandatory), SAML assertion mapping, and fine-grained RBAC as contract commitments. We need a packaging experiment that reduces negotiation time while preserving pricing leverage for advanced access controls.

Hypothesis: If we standardize a baseline enterprise contract that includes SSO (IdP metadata import, SAML) as a core entitlement and offer RBAC as an optional add-on (either pre-bundled in a ‘Security+’ tier or sold as an attachment with explicit SLAs), average sales cycle for mid-market deals will shorten by 20% and legal redlines will drop 30%.

Scope: This ticket governs the product & contract language experiment design, pricing guardrails, and the telemetry needed to evaluate impact. Implementation work (console UI changes, RBAC enforcement controls) will be tracked in ENG tickets referenced in dependencies.

Deliverables: proposed contract language snippets, packaging tier descriptions for quoting, pricing band recommendations, experiment cohort definition, and an operational rollout checklist for Sales/Legal/CS.
acceptance_criteria: Draft contract text for SSO/SAML baseline and RBAC add-on reviewed by Legal
Pricing envelopes for baseline vs Security+ tier documented and approved by Finance
Experiment cohort and measurement plan agreed with Sales and CS
Customer-facing quoting text and internal playbook drafted and linked
success_metrics: Median sales cycle (lead->signed) reduction by >=20% for cohort
Reduction in contract negotiation touchpoints (redlines) by >=30%
Percentage of new enterprise deals selecting RBAC add-on (target 25%)
Net new ARR attributable to Security+ tier or RBAC add-on after 3 months
proposed_contract_language: SSO/SAML (Baseline): Redwood will provide SAML 2.0 compatible SSO integration. Customer will supply IdP metadata and an SP-initiated consumer URL. Redwood will support user provisioning via SAML attributes (name, email, groups) as described in Appendix A.

RBAC (Optional Add-on): Redwood will offer role-based access controls as an optional add-on including: custom role definitions, group-to-role mapping, and API-scoped permissions. Service commitments for RBAC (availability and role propagation timing) will be specified in Addendum B when purchased.

Security SLAs: For customers purchasing Security+ or RBAC add-on, Redwood commits to a 99.9% uptime SLA on the control plane relevant to auth configuration changes and will provide an audit log export for all role/permission changes within the contract retention period.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Legal drafts and internal review of contract clauses (owner: Legal)
Week 2: Finance sets pricing envelopes and discount guardrails (owner: Finance)
Week 3: Sales enablement (playbook, objection handling, canned email templates) and CS onboarding
Week 4: Pilot with 5 inbound mid-market opportunities; log negotiation time and redlines
Week 8: Analyze pilot metrics, iterate contract language, decision to expand or rollback
